title_zh: 圍產期心理健康深造單元 PN1 網上課程簡介會（11 月 24 日，免費）
title_en: Perinatal mental health PN1 online open event 24 November 2026
summary_zh: Tavistock 將於 2026 年 11 月 24 日舉行免費網上簡介會，介紹圍產期心理健康深造單元 PN1 的課程理念、入學要求、評核與學分。對象為現職 NHS 專科圍產期心理健康崗位、有意報讀者，可與課程團隊見面及聽取舊生經驗。
summary_en: Tavistock Education and Training hosts a free online open event on Tuesday, November 24, 2026 (11:30 a.m.-12:30 p.m.) introducing its Perinatal Mental Health (PN1) postgraduate module. The session covers the course philosophy, entry requirements, assessment and credits, with a chance to meet the course team and hear from former students. It is aimed at professionals in NHS specialist perinatal mental health roles considering the module.

related.title_zh: RCT：孕期數碼治療 RELAX 可減低焦慮惡化，八週 GAD-7 平均低 1.5 分（268 人）
related.title_en: RELAX perinatal digital intervention prevents increasing anxiety RCT
related.summary_zh: 倫敦國王學院主導的二期隨機對照試驗，268 名高反覆負面思考、輕至中度焦慮的孕婦（16–28 週），比較自導式數碼治療 RELAX（八週 12 節：8 節網上＋4 節 SMS，含詮釋偏誤修正訓練）加常規照顧與單用常規照顧。八週時 RELAX 組 GAD-7 平均低 1.5 分（95% CI −2.4 至 −0.6；效應量 −0.42），抑鬱（PHQ-9 −0.8、EPDS −1.1）、反覆負面思考（−2.7）、憂慮（−3.6）與圍產期焦慮（PASS −5.5）亦較低；焦慮惡化者常規組佔 8.2%，RELAX 組只佔 1.5%。至 36 週時，一般焦慮、產後抑鬱與反覆負面思考的效果維持。
related.summary_en: A phase 2b randomised clinical trial led by King's College London randomised 268 pregnant participants with high repetitive negative thinking and up to moderate anxiety (16-28 weeks' gestation) to the self-led digital intervention RELAX (12 sessions over 8 weeks: 8 online plus 4 SMS sessions, including cognitive bias modification for interpretation) plus usual care or usual care alone. At 8 weeks, GAD-7 was 1.5 points lower in the RELAX arm (95% CI -2.4 to -0.6; effect size -0.42), with depression (PHQ-9 -0.8, EPDS -1.1), repetitive negative thinking (-2.7), worry (-3.6) and perinatal anxiety (PASS -5.5) also lower; anxiety deteriorated in 8.2% of the usual-care arm versus 1.5% of the RELAX arm. Effects on general anxiety, postnatal depression and repetitive negative thinking were sustained at 36 weeks.

related.title_zh: 新竹免費線上課：孕產照護人員學正念自我疼惜（11 月 12 日）
related.title_en: Hsinchu free online MSC training perinatal care workers
related.summary_zh: 新竹市衛生局與新竹市社區心理衛生中心主辦的免費線上培訓。2026 年 11 月 12 日（星期四）14:00-16:00 以 Microsoft Teams 線上授課，由鍾雅惠諮商心理師主講「孕產心理健康守門員——正念自我疼惜（MSC）於孕產期心理照護之理論與實務應用」，對象為新竹市孕產婦照護人員，限額 100 人，11 月 6 日截止報名。
related.summary_en: A free online training from the Hsinchu City Health Bureau and Hsinchu City Community Mental Health Center. On 12 November 2026 (Thursday) 14:00-16:00, via Microsoft Teams, Chung Ya-Hui, counseling psychologist, presents mindful self-compassion (MSC) in perinatal mental health care theory and practice, for perinatal care workers in Hsinchu City. Places are limited to 100; registration closes 6 November.

training.provider: 新竹市衛生局、新竹市社區心理衛生中心

related.title_zh: Anna Freud 的校本 CBT 計畫 MindWorks 進入 30 間學校做 RCT
related.title_en: Anna Freud's MindWorks school CBT programme enters RCT
related.summary_zh: MindWorks 是 Anna Freud 開發、以系統取向為基礎的 CBT 計畫，對象為 11–16 歲學生，由受訓的教育心理健康從業員等在一個學期內提供，並把家長與學校職員納入。計畫由 Youth Endowment Fund 資助，2026 年 9 月起在英格蘭 30 間主流與另類學校推行，Ending Youth Violence Lab 以 720 名兒童進行隨機對照試驗。
related.summary_en: MindWorks, a systemic CBT programme for 11–16-year-olds developed by Anna Freud, launches in 30 English schools from September 2026 and is being evaluated in an RCT of 720 children by the Ending Youth Violence Lab.
